title: Campaign ledger
brief_clause: Start with an empty but well-defined campaign ledger; add timestamp, source, channel, eligible sessions, clicks and reported orders only when obtained from authorized first-party reports. Keep a dated provenance trail. No conversion score or revenue forecast is presented here.
why_it_is_empty: Every field in this ledger describes something that only exists inside an Amazon Associates account or a webmaster tool. Nothing in this repository has read either. A row typed here by an agent pass would be a fabricated number wearing a provenance costume, which is the failure this whole project has spent thirteen passes trying not to have.

columns.label: Period start
columns.rule: ISO date, the first day of the reporting period as Amazon labels it.

columns.label: Source
columns.rule: The exact report the numbers came from, named and linked. 'Associates Central > Reports > Tracking ID Summary' or 'Search Console > Performance'. Not 'analytics'.

columns.label: Channel
columns.rule: The tracking ID or sub-tag the period covers, if the report is broken down that way. Blank until sub-tag IDs are confirmed to exist (Q-28).

columns.label: Eligible sessions
columns.rule: Only as the report states it. Amazon defines a session as beginning at the click through a Special Link; the site does not compute it.

columns.label: Clicks
columns.rule: Only as the report states it. Never derived from the on-device ledger, which is per-visitor and cannot aggregate.

columns.label: Reported orders
columns.rule: Only as the report states it, in the units the report uses.

columns.label: Recorded on
columns.rule: ISO date the human read the report and typed the row.

columns.label: Recorded by
columns.rule: Who read it. For any number that will drive a decision, a session id is not enough - the report was read in a logged-in account.

columns.label: Notes
columns.rule: Anything that changes how the row should be read: a promotion that ended, a period with no outbound links live, a tracking ID created mid-period.

derivation_rules: Conversion rate is not stored. It is clicks over sessions or orders over clicks, and which one is defensible depends on the report's own definitions; if the site ever shows one it will be computed at build time from the two stored columns and labelled with its denominator.

Revenue is not stored and no forecast is computed here. The published commission table gives rates by category, and no row in this register establishes which category Amazon assigned to a given ASIN (Q-11 stays open).
A row is never edited. If a number is corrected, the correction is a new row with its own obtained_on, and the superseded row keeps a pointer to it.
provenance_gate: check_campaign_ledger() in build.py fails the build if any row lacks source, obtained_on or period_start, or if a row cites a source host that is not in data/sources.json. The gate is the point of the file: without it, the ledger is a place to put a number you liked.
first_rows_expected_from: Associates Central > Reports, once the account passes review (Q-03) and one tagged link has been live long enough to register.
Search Console query data, once the site is verified (SG-29), which is also what chooses the next topic instead of a hunch.
rows_note: 0 rows at publication. This count is computed by the build, not typed.
